title: Existence of K-injective resolutions of sheaves of modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category is small (its objects form a set) and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Then the abelian category $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] (it has all colimits, filtered colimits are exact, and $\bigoplus_{U\in\operatorname{Ob}\mathcal C}j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is a generator, where $\mathcal O_U$ is the restriction of $\mathcal O$ to the localized site $\mathcal C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] and $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the extension-by-zero presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $P_{\mathcal O_U}$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]), and every cochain complex $\mathcal M^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] admits a K-injective resolution [def-pur-kinjective-complex] $\mathcal M^\bullet\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ which is injective in every degree [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and which can be chosen functorially in $\mathcal M^\bullet$ (a functor $\mathcal M^\bullet\mapsto\mathcal I^\bullet$ on the category of complexes with a natural transformation from the identity whose components are such resolutions).

proof.text: Compose PresheafOfModules.freeAdjunction with the module sheafification adjunction [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Its right adjoint is faithful: it forgets the sheaf condition, restricts scalars along the identity, and forgets to presheaves of sets. For two module-sheaf maps agreeing after every map from a sheafified free lifted representable, adjunction naturality gives equality after every map from a lifted representable into the underlying presheaf. Mathlib hom_ext_uliftYoneda then gives equality. This proves that precisely the family in the Lean statement is separating, without identifying the object and morphism universes.

source.place: Tag 03EW, generator argument; free-module and sheafification adjunctions

proof.text: Apply ObjectProperty.IsSeparating.isSeparator_coproduct to this family. Mathlib gives abelianness [lem-pur-ringed-site-module-category-abelian] and all colimits in the common universe. The source-library preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf and Mathlib preservation of finite limits and reflection of isomorphisms transfer exact filtered colimits from abelian sheaves by HasExactColimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor. The resulting AB5OfSize and HasSeparator instances give IsGrothendieckAbelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. This is the source-library Grothendieck argument applied directly with independent site universes; its equal-universe localized-generator wrapper is unnecessary.

proof.text: Install the Grothendieck instance from the preceding step. Apply [lem-pur-kinjective-degreewise-existence], realized by CochainComplex.kInjectiveResolutionFunctor and CochainComplex.toKInjectiveResolution. The second projection of monoQuasiIso_toKInjectiveResolution_app proves the components are quasi-isomorphisms; isKInjective_kInjectiveResolutionFunctor_obj and injective_kInjectiveResolutionFunctor_obj_X provide K-injectivity and injectivity in every degree. Package this functor and natural transformation together with the Grothendieck and specified-generator conclusions.
